cases.condition: Shell, Python, geturl, plugin, jump, if, variable, or dynamic run control is present.
cases.minimum_next_action: Remove executable control surfaces and retain only the reviewed declarative subset.

cases.condition: A literal include escapes the root, cycles, duplicates, or is not hash-bound.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore a unique in-root content-addressed include closure.

cases.condition: The units style or unit-specific semantic map is absent or inconsistent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Declare the exact LAMMPS units style and meanings without silent conversion.

cases.condition: The exact executable and build manifest does not prove a required package or style.
cases.minimum_next_action: Capture the exact executable hash, build configuration, package list, and style inventory.

cases.condition: Topology, pair coefficients, potential files, unit metadata, or independent license provenance is incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Hash-bind the complete model and topology closure and resolve independent terms.

cases.condition: An atom group is unintegrated or integrated by multiple fixes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Define exactly one compatible integrating fix for every intended atom group.

cases.condition: A new stochastic initialization lacks the exact seed.
cases.minimum_next_action: Record every velocity or thermostat stochastic seed explicitly.

cases.condition: A binary restart is treated as portable or bitwise exact without same-build evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind parent, version, build, and platform and limit the claim to supported statistical continuation.

cases.condition: Lost atoms, ERROR, WARNING, non-finite values, or a missing Loop time marker appears.
cases.minimum_next_action: Diagnose the first adverse event and provide one exact unsuppressed log segment.

cases.condition: Effective sample count or uncertainty fails the predeclared rule.
cases.minimum_next_action: Extend or replicate the unchanged predeclared production protocol.

cases.condition: The trajectory uses triclinic, scaled, general-triclinic, or unknown columns outside parser coverage.
cases.minimum_next_action: Add a version-matched parser and adversarial fixtures for the exact dump variant.

cases.condition: No pinned task recipe exists for the requested operation, or one or more recipe parameters remain unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Select a pinned recipe and resolve every declared placeholder before presenting or launching a provider command.

cases.condition: The selected executable is absent, its version banner is not exactly LAMMPS (4 Jul 2026), or required styles are missing from the fixed safe probe.
cases.minimum_next_action: Run the fixed safe probe against the intended executable or retain native-not-run without inventing provider evidence.

cases.condition: The exact manual, native capability, input, and evidence gates pass and a real provider run is requested, but exact-scope execution authorization is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain explicit authorization for the exact command, script closure, executable, host, resources, output tree, and time or cost boundary.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact evidence, or installation, scheduling, remote access, network access, or resource control is requested outside a declared authorized route.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and obtain separately authenticated evidence plus the required scope authority.
